program.name: Engine Builder
program.subject: Conditioning
program.blurb: A bigger engine from long, steady work: a long circuit one day, a long EMOM the next.
program.about: Conditioning from long, steady efforts rather than all-out bursts. One day is a long circuit of a squat, a pull, a push, a swing and a cardio move; the other a long EMOM of the same kinds. You should be able to keep going the whole time. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III asks for heavier weights.
